SessionStart.prompt: Silently check if project documentation may be stale. Run: git log --oneline -10 --diff-filter=M -- '*.go' 'go.mod' and git log --oneline -5 -- 'CLAUDE.md' 'README.md' 'docs/*.md'. If more than 5 code commits exist without a doc update, print ONE line: 'Docs may be stale. Run /update-docs to sync.' Otherwise say nothing.

PostToolUse.prompt: If the tool was Write or Edit on a file matching cmd/rootline/*.go, internal/*/*.go, or go.mod, silently note docs may need updating. Only after the user completes their current task, append: 'Tip: Code changes may affect docs. Consider /update-docs when ready.' Do nothing for non-Go files.
